example.text: Zhirenshe pauses only briefly before observing that sleep, when it arrives after a day of arduous toil, eclipses every other pleasure known to humankind.
From that day forward, Zhirenshe's counsel is sought above all others, and his reputation as the wisest man on the steppe continues to grow with each passing year.
Summoning every ounce of courage, Er Tostik drew his sword and galloped to the foot of the tree, shouting a challenge that echoed through the underground halls.
Feigning terror, he glances over the rich man's shoulder and cries out that a pack of wolves is racing toward them across the steppe.

Though he was born into humble circumstances, Zhirenshe has, through sheer force of intellect, earned a reputation for wisdom that extends across the entire steppe, ultimately securing his position as the khan's most indispensable advisor.
If I lose my temper, they will say I am guilty, he thought.
